33731-the-span-o-life-a-tale-of-louisbou.title: The Span O Life A Tale Of Louisbourg Quebec
33731-the-span-o-life-a-tale-of-louisbou.creator: WILLIAM McLENNAN
33731-the-span-o-life-a-tale-of-louisbou.description: A book by WILLIAM McLENNAN. Every one knows of my connection with the ill-starred Rebellion of Prince Charles, and for this it was that I found myself, a few months after the disaster of Culloden, lying close in an obscure lodging in Greek Street, Soho, London.

arxiv-1903-06311.title: Quantifying Bell: the Resource Theory of Nonclassicality of Common-Cause Boxes
arxiv-1903-06311.creator: Elie Wolfe, David Schmid, Ana Belén Sainz, Ravi Kunjwal, Robert W. Spekkens
arxiv-1903-06311.description: Abstract We take a resource-theoretic approach to the problem of quantifying nonclassicality in Bell scenarios. The resources are conceptualized as probabilistic processes from the setting variables to the outcome variables having a particular causal structure, namely, one wherein the wings are only connected by a common cause. We term them “common-cause boxes”.

arxiv-1907-12093.title: Taxable Stock Trading with Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-1907-12093.creator: Shan Huang
arxiv-1907-12093.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose stock trading based on the average tax basis. Recall that when selling stocks, capital gain should be taxed while capital loss can earn certain tax rebate. We learn the optimal trading strategies with and without considering taxes by reinforcement learning.

arxiv-2205-13357.title: The Document Vectors Using Cosine Similarity Revisited
arxiv-2205-13357.creator: Zhang Bingyu, Nikolay Arefyev
arxiv-2205-13357.description: Abstract The current state-of-the-art test accuracy (97.42%) on the IMDB movie reviews dataset was reported by Thongtan and Phienthrakul 2019 and achieved by the logistic regression classifier trained on the Document Vectors using Cosine Similarity (DV-ngrams-cosine) proposed in their paper and the Bag-of-N-grams (BON) vectors scaled by Naive Bayesian weights.

arxiv-2207-05972.title: Onsite and intersite electronic correlations in the Hubbard model for halide perovskites
arxiv-2207-05972.creator: Jiyuan Yang, Tianyuan Zhu, Shi Liu
arxiv-2207-05972.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jiyuan Yang, Tianyuan Zhu, Shi Liu. Halide perovskites (HPs) are widely viewed as promising photovoltaic and light-emitting materials for their suitable band gaps in the visible spectrum. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations employing (semi)local exchange-correlation functionals usually underestimate the band gaps for these systems. Accurate descriptions of the electronic structures of HPs often demand higher-order levels of theory such as the Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE) hybrid density functional and G ​ W GW approximations that are much more computationally expensive than standard DFT.

arxiv-2209-01927.title: Gather - a better way to codehack online
arxiv-2209-01927.creator: Rika Kobayashi 1. Leonard Huxley Building 56Australian National UniversityCanberra, Australia2. University of QueenslandBrisbane, Australia Rika.Kobayashi@anu.edu.au, Sarah Jaffa Advanced Research Computing CentreUniversity College LondonLondon, United Kingdom s.jaffa@ucl.ac.uk Jiachen DongUniversit
arxiv-2209-01927.description: Abstract A virtual hands-on computer laboratory has been designed within the Gather online meeting platform. Gather’s features such as spatial audio, private spaces and interactable objects offer scope for great improvements over currently used platforms, especially for small-group based teaching.

arxiv-2209-08753.title: Preservation of NATP Thanks: † The first author was supported by a KIAS Individual Grant (CG079801) at Korea Institute for Advanced Study. ‡ The second author was supported by a KIAS Individual Grant (6G091801) at Korea Institute for Advanced Study. ‡,∗ The second and third author were supported by
arxiv-2209-08753.creator: JinHoo Ahn †, Joonhee Kim ‡, Hyoyoon Lee ∗, Junguk Lee ∗∗
arxiv-2209-08753.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by JinHoo Ahn †, Joonhee Kim ‡, Hyoyoon Lee ∗, Junguk Lee ∗∗. We prove preservation theorems for NATP; many of them extend the previously established preservation results for other model-theoretic tree properties. Using them, we also furnish proper examples of NATP theories which are simultaneously TP 2 and SOP. First, we show that NATP is preserved by the parametrization and sum of the theories of Fraïssé limits of Fraïssé classes satisfying strong amalgamation property.

arxiv-2301-12672.title: Analysis of anisotropic subgrid-scale stress for coarse large-eddy simulation
arxiv-2301-12672.creator: Kazuhiro Inagaki (稲垣 和寛), Hiromichi Kobayashi (小林 宏充)
arxiv-2301-12672.description: Abstract This study discusses the necessity of anisotropic subgrid-scale (SGS) stress in large-eddy simulations (LESs) of turbulent shear flows using a coarse grid resolution. We decompose the SGS stress into two parts to observe the role of SGS stress in turbulent shear flows in addition to the energy transfer between grid-scale (GS or resolved scale) and SGS.

arxiv-2308-12215.title: [SoK] The Challenges of Machine Learning for Trust and Safety: A Case Study on Misinformation Detection
arxiv-2308-12215.creator: Madelyne Xiao, Jonathan Mayer
arxiv-2308-12215.description: Abstract We examine the disconnect between scholarship and practice in applying machine learning to trust and safety problems, using misinformation detection as a case study. We systematize literature on automated detection of misinformation across a corpus of 270 well-cited papers in the field. We then examine subsets of papers for data and code availability, design missteps, reproducibility, and generalizability.

arxiv-2310-07184.title: NeuroInspect: Interpretable Neuron-based Debugging Framework through Class-conditional Visualizations
arxiv-2310-07184.creator: Yeong-Joon Ju, Ji-Hoon Park, Seong-Whan Lee
arxiv-2310-07184.description: Abstract Despite deep learning (DL) has achieved remarkable progress in various domains, the DL models are still prone to making mistakes. This issue necessitates effective debugging tools for DL practitioners to interpret the decision-making process within the networks. However, existing debugging methods often demand extra data or adjustments to the decision process, limiting their applicability.

arxiv-2311-15371.title: From nonreciprocal to charge-4e supercurrents in Ge-based Josephson devices with tunable harmonic content
arxiv-2311-15371.creator: Axel Leblanc, Chotivut Tangchingchai, Zahra Sadre Momtaz, Elyjah Kiyooka, Jean-Michel Hartmann, Gonzalo Troncoso Fernandez-Bada, Boris Brun-Barriere, Vivien Schmitt, Simon Zihlmann, Romain Maurand, Étienne Dumur, Silvano De Franceschi, François Lefloch
arxiv-2311-15371.description: Abstract Hybrid superconductor(S)-semiconductor(Sm) devices bring a range of new functionalities into superconducting circuits. In particular, hybrid parity-protected qubits and Josephson diodes were recently proposed and experimentally demonstrated. Such devices leverage the non-sinusoidal character of the Josephson current-phase relation (CPR) in highly transparent S-Sm-S junctions.

arxiv-2501-12458.title: First photometric investigation of V517 Cam combined with ground-based and TESS data
arxiv-2501-12458.creator: Neslihan Alan, Fahri Aliçavuş, Mehmet Alpsoy
arxiv-2501-12458.description: Abstract The observations of eclipsing binary systems are of great importance in astrophysics, as they allow direct measurements of fundamental stellar parameters. By analysing high-quality space-based observations with ground-based photometric data, it becomes possible to detect these fundamental parameters with greater precision using multicolour photometry.

pmc-10672436.title: The Role of Specialized Instruments for Advanced Endoscopic Resections in Gastrointestinal Disease
pmc-10672436.creator: Markus Brand, Karl-Hermann Fuchs, Joel Troya, Alexander Hann, Alexander Meining, Huang-Ping Yu, Shinichiro Kashiwagi
pmc-10672436.description: Introduction: Advanced endoscopic therapy techniques have been developed and have created alternative treatment options to surgical therapy for several gastrointestinal diseases. This work will focus on new endoscopic tools for special indications of advanced endoscopic resections (ER), especially endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD), which were developed in our institution. This paper aims to analyze these specialized instruments and identify their status.

pmc-11424946.title: Biological functions of extracellular vesicles from mammalian cells
pmc-11424946.creator: Jean M. Kanellopoulos, Frédéric Rieux-Laucat, David M. Ojcius
pmc-11424946.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are enclosed by a phospholipid bilayer and can be secreted by most types of cells. EVs deliver cargo from the secreting cell into the cytoplasm of recipient cells, influencing the function of the recipient cells. EVs are attracting increasing attention from a broad range of clinicians and scientists due to their ability to promote or inhibit various physiological pathways or pathological conditions.

pmc-11666502.title: Immune and physiological responses in Penaeus monodon to ammonia-N stress: a multi-omics approach
pmc-11666502.creator: Zhi Luo, Falin Zhou, Song Jiang, Jianhua Huang, Lishi Yang, Qibin Yang, Jianzhi Shi, Erchao Li, Zhenhua Ma, Yundong Li
pmc-11666502.description: Ammonia-N stress is a significant environmental factor that adversely affects the health and productivity of aquaculture species. This study investigates the effects of ammonia-N stress on the shrimp Penaeus monodon through a combination of biochemical, histological, transcriptomic, and metabolomic analyses.

pmc-12484158.title: Serum Krebs von den Lungen-6 before treatment predicts the prognosis of lung cancer in Asian populations: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12484158.creator: Hong Huang, Liangyu Fu, Chenye Feng, Jiawei Zhou, Jiahuan Xu, Jianjun Sun, Ying Pan, Delei Kong, Wei Wang
pmc-12484158.description: BackgroundUp until now, no clear consensus has been reached on the role of serum Krebs von den Lungen-6 (KL-6) levels in predicting survival in patients with lung cancer. This meta-analysis aimed to assess the prognostic value of serum KL-6 levels before treatment in lung cancer.

pmc-13180509.title: Identification of Poor Prognosis-Associated Fibroblast Subpopulation Signature Genes Utilizing the Scissor Algorithm to Classify Colorectal Cancer Subtypes and Evaluate the Immune Landscape
pmc-13180509.creator: Meng Wang, Jianhui Gu, Jie Zhang, Xing Wen
pmc-13180509.description: Background/AimsColorectal cancer (CRC) shows high heterogeneity. Conventional bulk transcriptome-based classification methods fail to capture the complex tumor microenvironment of CRC, limiting precision therapy advances. The Scissor algorithm integrates single-cell/bulk transcriptomic data with clinical information to identify prognosis-linked cell subpopulations, offering new insights into tumor heterogeneity resolution.

pmc-13458037.title: Isolation of Kombucha Microorganisms for Application in Perilla Beverage Fermentation
pmc-13458037.creator: Nguyen Tri Yen Chi, Nhat Anh Duong, Tran Tuan Kiet Nguyen, Tran Quang Nho
pmc-13458037.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The increasing consumer demand for kombucha in Vietnam necessitates the development of standardized microbial starter cultures for functional beverage production. This study isolated and evaluated microbial consortia from five commercial kombucha samples using selective media: Yeast extract Peptone Glycerol Dextrose (YPGD) for acetic acid bacteria (AAB), MRS for lactic acid bacteria (LAB), and Yeast extract Peptone Dextrose Agar (YPDA) for yeasts. Based on morphological and biochemical characteristics, a total of 22 AAB strains, 6 LAB strains, and 9 yeast isolates were recovered.

pmc-13661615.title: Chitosan-fibrinogen-thrombin matrix accelerates re-epithelialization and cornification in a rat wound healing model
pmc-13661615.creator: Hind Lerhcha, Anik Chevrier, Marc Lavertu
pmc-13661615.description: This study evaluated a chitosan-fibrinogen-thrombin (CFT) matrix enriched with autologous skin cells and a fatty acid sodium salt (FASS) to enhance wound closure and regeneration. A rat excisional wound model compared six treatments: CFT with or without autologous cells and/or FASS, lubricating jelly, and cell suspension alone. Wounds were splinted and assessed at day 14.
